test_title: PYST 74: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6061ad5e9776aae7026862c04092ab5d2a6ffdd29e34f48f300f86b80efa1e51.png] 

The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: MQO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04898d6fadbeb0f99377c0d44619a524ce22b2d7064c222c48548c11534bd3e2.png] 

Option 2: GKI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37c8f67cc3b6952ec104d1ec6156e64b0c8c8e15ece07b308777df418a54b5df.png] 

Option 3: QUS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d93c78075ac94ef9077ac33619c71d943242b3c1dbdd10d3403baab6a307341.png] 

Option 4: OSU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4b1d9fb97d06473361018dab872735ac2efc1fc7f810c16b1283b17424e7f5.png] 

Thus, OSU does not follow the given pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 4.**
